0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_GREETING_KAISHIRR_000_000
0.description: Got everything? It ain't got to be perfect. Whatever you have'll probably be fine!

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_GREETING_KAISHIRR_000_001
1.description: How're the cooking supplies coming along?

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_GREETING_KAISHIRR_000_002
2.description: I still haven't found a singer, though I reckon it's only a matter of time until I do! Any progress with the bits and pieces for the costume?

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_GREETING_KAISHIRR_000_003
3.description: I don't hardly know anything about airships, but you've been on a few, right? Hopefully that'll make your job a bit easier.

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_GREETING_KAISHIRR_000_004
4.description: A pleasant <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> to you <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>... How did that sound? I'm trying to brush up my manners. Gotta make a good impression, you know?

44.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_TUTORIAL_000_000
44.description: Help Kai-Shirr achieve his goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with him and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_TUTORIAL_001_000
55.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Kai-Shirr's trust.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_TUTORIAL_001_001
56.description: With each successful delivery, Kai-Shirr will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Kai-Shirr's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your business partner.

57.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_TUTORIAL_001_002
57.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Kai-Shirr needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_001_000
59.description: So you've brought the stuff for making the flyers? Let's have a look, then.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_001_001
60.description: The ingredients used in our new recipes are fairly cheap, but if we don't go the extra malm with the utensils and all that, it'll end up being the same as what they serve down in Gatetown.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_001_002
61.description: Ah, yes. We should be able to make a pretty costume out of this lot.

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_001_003
62.description: While I managed to get a lot of the basic materials from Venmont Yards, you're the only one I know who can put together the trickier things on Colden's list.

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_001_004
63.description: I've been scratching my head trying to come up with a decent souvenir for the folks from the Crystarium. But you've got an eye for quality, so I trust your judgment more than my own!

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_002_000
64.description: If we grind this down and mix it with water, we'll have ink for flyers! Clever, isn't it?

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_002_001
65.description: If we sprinkle a bit of spice and that on top, it makes all the difference!

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_002_002
66.description: Pretty jewels, eh? It's incredible to think about all the treasures out there, waiting to be found. I suppose only an expert like you would know where to look, though.

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_002_003
67.description: Funny what you can find lying around, isn't it? 'Course, once it's been all cleaned up and whatnot, none of the passengers'll know where you got it!

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_002_004
68.description: Kholusian gems, eh? Not a bad idea! I hear ones like these are a bugger to find anywhere else.

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_003_000
69.description: Most flyers use plain old black ink, but I want ours to stand out. Wringing out these little buggers will give us a nice purple, which you'll have noticed is a popular color in Eulmore.

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_003_001
70.description: The fishwives down in Stilltide talk about these like they're worth their weight in gold. Mind you, they're a bugger to catch by all accounts, so that might actually be the case.

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_003_002
71.description: Oho, pearls! These would normally cost a fortune─lucky for us, you know how to find them!

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_003_003
72.description: Colden came up with the idea to use these as decorations on the airships. Mind you, with Kholusia being surrounded by the sea, it's a pretty good choice, if you ask me.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_KNOWLEDGE_KAISHIRR_003_004
73.description: Maybe we should call this something fancy like “Bounty of the Blue.” They'll probably want to eat it quick before it starts to reek, though, especially on a hot day.

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_JUDGEMENT_KAISHIRR_000_000
74.description: All right, what have we got here? Hmm... That should do the trick.

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_JUDGEMENT_KAISHIRR_000_001
75.description: Hello, hello! What's this? Blimey, I weren't expecting this sort of quality! Nicely done!

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_JUDGEMENT_KAISHIRR_000_002
76.description: Bloody hells, I'm amazed! You've really taken it to another level with this!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_JUDGEMENT_KAISHIRR_000_003
77.description: I won't pretend I know much about airships, but I do know quality when I see it. That looks pretty damn good to me!

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_JUDGEMENT_KAISHIRR_000_004
78.description: Oh, look at that! It's almost a shame to give it away for free, though. Maybe we could start flogging these on the side?

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_FULLBAG_000_000
79.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_FULLBAG_000_001
80.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Kai-Shirr once more.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_BEFRANKUP_KAISHIRR_000_000
81.description: Well, we've got everything we need for the flyers. All that's left is to print them...

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_BEFRANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_000
82.description: Now that Anfrigg's got everything he asked for, we'll have a new, and more importantly, affordable menu ready in no time!

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_BEFRANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_000
83.description: I'd say we've got enough bits and pieces to put together a pretty decent costume. And I'm happy to say...I've found a singer!

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_BEFRANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_000
84.description: That ought to do it! I'll get this lot off to the soldiers and shipwrights working on the fleet. I'll bet they'll be chuffed to bits when they see what you've come up with!

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_000
85.description: Bosta-Zia and Anfrigg offered to help, so I gave them a load of flyers to put up around the villages near Eulmore.

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_001
86.description: I even convinced the Queen Bee to let us attach free drink vouchers to them. No one in their right mind would turn down an offer like that, so we've had a steady stream of new customers!

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_001_002
87.description: Giving away a bit of booze is one thing, getting them to stay is another. Most of them left after the free one!

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_003
88.description: Well, judging by the way they were necking their drinks and gawping at the dancers, they were definitely having a good time. I wonder what the problem was?

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_001_004
89.description: From what I gather, those two over there are from Wright. Maybe we should ask them what they think of the Beehive?

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CITIZENA00640_001_005
90.description: You're not here to kick us out, are you?

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_001_006
91.description: Why, nothing could be further from my mind. I was hoping that you might share your impressions of our establishment.

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CITIZENB00640_001_007
92.description: Eh? Oh, you're asking what we think of the place... Ha! Anywhere that gives away booze like <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> for nothing is all right in my book!

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CITIZENA00640_001_008
93.description: And I love the interior! What's the word...gaudy? No, no, no... Vibrant! Yes, that's it.

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_001_009
94.description: Well then, if you're happy, then so are we!

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_001_010
95.description: And yet we're not seeing a lot of people coming back after their first visit. Could it be the food and drink aren't to their liking?

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CITIZENB00640_001_011
96.description: Perish the thought! This complimentary beverage is one of the finest things I've ever tasted. I shall savor it while it lasts...

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CITIZENA00640_001_012
97.description: We'd like to have another, maybe try some of the food...but we simply can't afford to. For the price of a single steak, we could feed ourselves for a week.

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_013
98.description: Hmm... I'll have a word with the manager and see if there ain't something we can do about it. Thank you for your time.

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_000
99.description: Well, it didn't take long for the new dishes to cause a stir among the customers. Anfrigg weren't kidding about his skills in the kitchen!

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_002_001
100.description: We're seeing more customers from Wright and Stilltide, and they're not only coming for the free drink. Our new food offerings are proving popular in their own right.

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_002
101.description: It's a step in the right direction, and we might even have gained a few regulars, but we'll need more than that to turn things around.

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_003
102.description: Don't worry, Zia, I'm already malms ahead of you. I made my way over to Tomra, where I handed out flyers and drink vouchers.

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_004
103.description: Tomra? You must've crossed some dangerous territory to get there. I have to say I'm a little impressed.

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_002_005
104.description: It was worth the journey, as we've seen a number of dwarven customers since then. Sadly, most of them have only made the one visit. They're not shy when it comes to ordering food and drink, so the problem must lie elsewhere.

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_005
105.description: In that case, why don't we try asking those two over there?

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_006
106.description: Good <hex:020835E3E90C0DFF17020813E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF0464617903FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> to you, gentlemen! Sorry to interrupt, but do you mind if we ask you a few questions?

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_DWARFA00640_102_007
109.description: Now then, you said you had some questions. You gave us free drinks, and the least we can do is hear you out, so ask away!

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_002_008
110.description: Well, I've noticed that the visitors from Tomra rarely come here more than once. Why do you think that could be?

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_DWARFB00640_002_009
111.description: It's no fault of the booze or the grub, I can tell you that much. Very tasty indeed, and a lot more fairly priced than you might expect in Eulmore.

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_010
112.description: I'm glad the food and drink are to your liking. So...what's the problem?

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_DWARFA00640_002_011
113.description: I hate to say it, lad, but this place is a bit on the dull side. The dancing is all well and good, but we dwarves can't enjoy our grog without an old-fashioned singsong! We've got songs for ale, songs for mead, songs for wine, something for every occasion.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_DWARFB00640_002_012
114.description: Well, every occasion that involves drinking, which is...all of them. But as soon as we try any of that in here, everyone looks at us like we'd just pissed all over the bar! At least if we had some proper singing instead of this “plinky plinky” rubbish, we could swig away to our hearts' content.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_013
115.description: Hmm... I didn't know dwarves were so musically inclined.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_014
116.description: I think that's all for now, gents. You've been very helpful.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_000
117.description: Choosing a vocalist would have been a lot easier if a few more people could actually sing... Most of the ones who auditioned were terrible! I think you'll be chuffed as I was with my final choice, though. And of course, she'll look the part too, thanks to all the things you brought for the costume.

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_001
118.description: Ah, I forgot to mention, Zia wanted to see us about something.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_002
119.description: I'm sure everything's fine! Well, reasonably sure.

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_003
120.description: Hopefully, it's good news, but there's only one way to find out.

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_000
121.description: We finally managed to get Colden everything he asked for. Since our part of the bargain is taken care of, all we have to do now is wait and see how things turn out.

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_001
122.description: Ah! I almost forgot to mention that Master Chai wanted to see us. We've been asked to meet him by the Xylem Lift. I reckon we've got some good news coming our way, so let's take Anfrigg and Zia along to hear it!

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_002
123.description: Thank you for coming on such short notice.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_004_003
124.description: What an honor it is to be joined by not only the Queen Bee himself, but the enchanting Mistress Mowen.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_MANAGER00640_004_004
125.description: We were enjoying one of our promenades when we chanced upon Master Chai, who graciously invited us to accompany him.

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_005
126.description: I'm lucky I ran into you, as I'd neglected to invite you from the outset. After all, with the fortunes of your respective businesses being so closely tied to those of Eulmore, this affects you more than most.

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_006
127.description: Kai-Shirr, your efforts have finally borne fruit.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_008
129.description: We can now commence airship flights to and from the Crystarium! Our newly repurposed fleet stands at the ready. As a matter of fact, preparations are now underway for our very first voyage.

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_009
130.description: We did it! Now the Beehive will be absolutely swarming with visitors! Especially once we put the next part of the plan into action.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_011
132.description: 'Course there is! We're not gonna wait for them to arrive to tell them about the Beehive. I'm looking into advertising in the Crystarium!

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_012
133.description: Once they hear about the high-class entertainment and affordable food and drink we have on offer, they'll be racing to get on those airships!

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_013
134.description: Hold on, I've got another idea. If we give them a little souvenir on the way out, they're bound to come back for more!

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_014
135.description: And when they get back to the Crystarium, they can show their friends and tell them about all the fun they had at the Beehive. That'll bring in even more customers!

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_MANAGER00640_004_016
137.description: My sentiments exactly. Hiring him on the spot was something of a gamble, but my faith has been repaid manifold!

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_004_017
138.description: Let's not count our amaro just yet. There's still a lot to do before any guests arrive.

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_004_018
139.description: Until then, we dancers'll be working on some brand-new routines. We'll show them such a good time, they'll never want to leave!

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_019
140.description: I never imagined that entertainment would be the key to turning around our fortunes, but here we are!

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_CHAINUZZ_004_020
141.description: I see great things ahead for you, Kai-Shirr. Though it is often said, “The proof is in the pudding,” I have every confidence you will see this through to its natural─and successful─conclusion.

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_100
142.description: I should've realized this sooner, but the Beehive only caters to the rich, and most people in Norvrandt just can't afford what we're charging. Trouble is, it's the ingredients that push the prices up. As for the booze, there have <hex:021A020203>got<hex:021A020103> to be cheaper alternatives.

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_101
143.description: I reckon we should expand the menu to include more affordable options. That way, there'll be something for everyone!

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_001_102
144.description: That's easier said than done. Quality doesn't come cheap, you know.

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_103
145.description: Well, you're not wrong there, Zia...

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_001_104
146.description: Have you forgotten about Eulmore's foremost barkeeper? There's a lot more to my job than mixing drinks morning, noon, and night. I can put together a whole selection that won't cost an arm and a leg.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_105
147.description: I like the sound of that!

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_001_106
148.description: The food, on the other hand, will take a lot more effort. I learned a few recipes during our days in Gatetown that use only basic ingredients. I should be able to adapt those into something a bit more befitting of the Beehive.

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_001_107
149.description: I'll have to ask you to bring me the supplies, though. My duties prevent me from leaving the Beehive for too long, so I'll give you a list of all the things I need.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_108
150.description: We'll sort it, don't you worry. I can start with the villages in Kholusia, and if I don't find what we need, I'll try casting the net a bit wider.

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_109
151.description: Tell you what, why don't you leave all the running around and haggling to me, while you take care of the stuff that needs an expert's touch? How's that sound?

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_100
153.description: If we want the dwarves to become regulars here, we need to make them feel at home─without making the other customers feel like they aren't.

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_101
154.description: I think it's time we offered a wider range of music, and I have just the thing in mind for those boisterous little buggers.

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ANFRIGG_002_102
155.description: You're not going to sing, are you? No offense, Zia, but I doubt that your brand of high-pitched caterwauling will go down too well.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_103
156.description: Oi! Watch it, you cheeky sod! I know full well where my talents lie, thank you very much. What I'm saying is that we find a singer to perform something simple enough for the dwarves to nod their heads to. With the Queen Bee's permission, of course.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_ZIABOSTA_002_104
157.description: We'll also need a proper costume. There are plenty for the dancers, but the vocalist should have something to make them stand out from the rest of us.

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_105
158.description: Sounds like a plan. But since you're basically tone deaf, you'd better leave finding a singer to me.

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_106
159.description: I dunno what to do about the costume, though. Unless...

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_107
160.description: ...We put <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> in charge of that? Can we count on you?

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_108
161.description: Great! Let's all get to work, then!

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_100
162.description: Blimey, did you hear what Master Chai was saying? I gotta tell you, it feels good having a man like him singing your praises. By the sounds of it, you're no stranger to that yourself.

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_101
163.description: He's got every reason to be optimistic, though. Everything's coming together nicely, and it's all thanks to you.

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_102
164.description: 'Course, we're not quite there yet, and we can't afford to get complacent.

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_103
165.description: But if the plan with the souvenirs pays off, everyone in the Crystarium'll be wanting to hop on an airship and sample the delights of the Beehive.

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_104
166.description: To be honest, I ain't got a clue what would make a decent souvenir. If you bring me whatever you think'll work, we'll take it from there!

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_105
167.description: Oh, and before you go charging off, there's one other thing I wanted to ask.

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_106
168.description: The Queen Bee is always going on about “clothes maketh the man” or something. The ones they gave me to wear when I joined make me presentable enough, but I want to look less like hired help and more like I belong here.

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_107
169.description: Don't worry, there's no need to donate half your wardrobe to me or nothing. I heard about those glamour prism thingies. They'll work just as well as shelling out on a new outfit.

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_LCUT_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_108
170.description: Mind you, I spent most of my life dressed in bits of old sack, so I wouldn't know where to start. Could you maybe pick something out for me? I hate to be a pain, but you've obviously got much better dress sense than me!

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_000_000
171.description: Kai-Shirr is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Backer of the Beehive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_000_001
172.description: Kai-Shirr is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Promoter of the Beehive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_000_002
173.description: Kai-Shirr is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pillar of the Beehive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_000_003
174.description: Kai-Shirr could not be happier with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of the Beehive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_001_001
175.description: And yet there is still much work to be done if the Beehive is to continue contributing to Eulmore's economy. To that end, Kai-Shirr has a new favor to ask of you...

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUPINFO_001_002
176.description: Through your efforts, the Beehive has become one of the primary reasons to visit Eulmore. It seems, however, that Kai-Shirr has a different sort of favor to ask of you...

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_000_001
177.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Kai-Shirr has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Kai-Shirr and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_001_001
178.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Beehive's efforts to attract new clientele is now available from Bosta-Zia. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Kai-Shirr will be updated.

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_002_001
179.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_002_002
180.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with Kai-Shirr and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_002_003
181.description: Note that Beehive souvenirs, Kholusian miscellany, and Kholusian king crabs will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_002_004
182.description: Furthermore, Kai-Shirr's appearance may now be altered through the use of glamours.

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTRANKUP_002_005
183.description: A new quest is available from Anfrigg in the Beehive. Completion of this quest will allow airship travel between Eulmore and the Crystarium.

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_000
184.description: I knew I was right to ask you for help!

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_001_001
185.description: You've really got an eye for quality and the skill to match. Still, I expect we'll both be kept busy in the days to come.

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_000
186.description: You've really come through for me, as always.

187.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_002_001
187.description: If all goes well, we'll have more visitors than this place has ever seen!

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_000
188.description: We must be doing something right because more and more people are arriving from the Crystarium every day!

189.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_001
189.description: To tell the truth, Anfrigg and the others are having trouble keeping up with all the orders, so maybe we should slow down for a bit.

190.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_003_002
190.description: I'll make sure things continue at a steady pace, so you may as well put your feet up. Either that or get back to charging about saving the world or whatever it is you do the rest of the time!

191.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_000
191.description: We're all really grateful to you for helping save the Beehive.

192.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_001
192.description: Anfrigg in particular is dead impressed by the work you've done for us. He was asking me if you'd be interested in packing in all that adventuring to become a honeybee here instead.

193.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_004_002
193.description: It ain't all dancing and pouring drinks, you know! Even Minard over there is one of them, and his job mainly involves decking people when they get a bit too “hands on” if you catch my meaning. Still, I didn't think you'd want to be tied to a job, which Anfrigg seemed to agree with.

194.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_005_000
194.description: I always wonder how you manage to be so bloody good at everything.

195.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_005_001
195.description: Zia was just saying to me that you're probably cut out to be a dancer. You'd better watch out, or she'll have you up on that stage!

196.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_005_002
196.description: Though I expect if you did give it a try, you'd put that lot to shame.

197.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_000
197.description: You've done so much for the place, I don't know where we'd be without you.

198.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_001
198.description: I shudder to think what would've happened if you and Alphinaud hadn't saved me that day.

199.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_002
199.description: I would've been dead, or worse─turned into an eater and then meol.

200.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_003
200.description: So much has happened since then...

201.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_004
201.description: And now, thanks to you, I'm happier than I've ever been. If there's ever anything I can do for you, just say the word.

202.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_005
202.description: I've been given a second chance, and I ain't gonna waste it!

203.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_RANKUP_KAISHIRR_006_006
203.description: Now, I know you've got a lot going on─“spinning lots of plates” as I heard one of the performers call it─but if you're ever in Eulmore and you feel like dropping in and maybe even lending a hand, we'd love to see you!

204.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
204.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Kai-Shirr. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

205.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_QUEST_KAISHIRR_000_000
205.description: I think Zia wanted to talk to us about something. It doesn't seem too urgent, so whenever you can spare a moment should be fine.

206.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER5_00640_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_001
206.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Bosta-Zia at the Beehive as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
